payload.name: Preserve all distinct claims in multi-claim utterances
payload.description: When extracting memory candidates from an utterance that describes multiple distinct activities, hobbies, or topics each with its own value, feeling, or outcome, ensure each distinct claim is preserved.
content: During candidate extraction, treat an utterance containing multiple independent claims as a set of distinct memory candidates; do not let one salient claim suppress another.
If combining claims into one memory, include every subject and its specific predicate; if any claim cannot be combined cleanly, emit a separate ADD candidate so all evidence-backed facts survive.

solves: A speaker utterance describes multiple distinct activities or topics, each with its own evaluation or benefit, and extraction preserves only the most salient claim, losing other evidence-backed facts. This skill applies whenever constructing memories from multi-claim utterances in any future session, regardless of topic, and does not require knowing the gold answer.
